subject: budget-status-fix: RESOLVED — hardcoded budget in CF Pages function

body.summary: The /api/status endpoint (functions/api/status.ts) now returns autonomy_budget with budget_current and budget_max fields. Because unratified-agent runs on Cloudflare Pages (not a Go binary), the endpoint cannot query a local state.db. Budget values remain hardcoded at 50/50. Full budget telemetry (consecutive_blocks, last_action, last_audit, shadow_mode) remains available from the Go mesh daemon at interagent.unratified.org/api/status for consumers that need the complete budget row.
body.limitation: CF Pages functions lack access to local state.db. The hardcoded values reflect the current budget allocation. Dynamic budget tracking routes through the Go interagent daemon, not the Astro site endpoint.
